purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/juki-mo-644d.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Juki America home page for MO-644D. Lists features, specs, accessories, MSRP, links to catalog and manual.
3 pages, text layer. Comparison table of MO-623, MO-644D, MO-654DE, MO-655, MO-735. Column assignment of some rows read from table order; verify against the PDF.

Linked from the MO-644D page but titled MO-644DN/654DEN. Spec page lists 220-240 V foot control, so it appears to be a 220-240 V edition; the DN suffix is not the model on our page. Treat as a close relative, not the same model document.
Generic Juki America home-machine warranty wording; the /warranty page is a registration form with no terms text. Not model-specific.

facts.value: 1500 spm (Max. 1500 spm)
facts.note: Catalog agrees: maximum 1,500 spm.

facts.value: 2/3/4 threads, 2 needles
facts.note: Catalog title: 2-Needle, 2/3/4 Thread Overlock with Automatic Rolled Hemming and Differential Feed.

facts.value: 2/3 thread converter is Optional on MO-644D, Standard on MO-654DE
facts.note: Catalog machine comparison table, 2/3 Thread Converter row. Not listed in the MO-644D page accessories.

site.label: 2-thread converter
site.juki: Optional (catalog). Not in the standard accessory list.

facts.value: 0.7 - 2.0 ratio
facts.spec_value: Yes, ratio published as 0.7 to 2.0; dial on the left side
facts.note: Ratio matches. Dial location: the page says the dial is on the exterior right hand side; our spec (from an owner site) says left. See contradiction row.

facts.value: Page: "located on the exterior right hand side"
facts.note: The page text (shared with the 654DE page wording) puts the dial on the exterior right. Our spec and patternreview owners say left. The manual (644DN) labels the knob but a text layer gives no side. Soft: check the manual diagram before publishing either side.

site.label: Differential dial location
site.others: Owner and dealer copy say left.

facts.value: 0.2 in (5 mm)
facts.note: Catalog and manual also give 5 mm.

facts.value: 15 lb (catalog: 7.0 kg / 15 lbs)
facts.note: Page and catalog both 15 lb; manual 7.0 kg (about 15.4 lb).

facts.value: Page: 10.6 in W x 13.5 in H x 11.5 in D. Catalog: 270 x 340 x 295 mm (W x D x H), about 10.6 x 13.4 x 11.6 in
facts.note: Axis order in our spec is unlabelled; figures agree within 0.1 in once depth is 13.4 and height 11.6. The page itself labels H 13.5 and D 11.5, the catalog labels depth 340 and height 295 mm. Maker documents disagree on which is height and which is depth.

site.label: Dimensions
site.juki: Page: 10.6 W x 13.5 H x 11.5 D in. Catalog: 270 W x 340 D x 295 H mm.
site.others: Our spec has 13.4 x 10.6 x 11.6, axes unlabelled.

facts.value: Page: Household (HAx1) #11-14. Manual (644DN): right and left needle 130/705H
facts.note: HAx1 and 130/705H are the same household flat-shank family; the page gives sizes 11 to 14 only.

facts.value: Left needle 6 mm, right needle 4 mm, rolled hem 2 mm; max overlock width 0.2 in (6 mm)
facts.spec_value: Left needle 6, right needle 4, rolled hem 2
facts.note: Manual page 34 gives the same figures for the 644DN.

site.label: Stitch width
site.juki: Left 6 mm, right 4 mm, rolled hem 2 mm.

facts.note: Catalog table gives rolled hem stitch length as 1.0 - 1.5 for the 2/3-thread models; the 644D row figure for rolled hem is not separately stated, so our 1.5 is not confirmed for 644D. Verify against the PDF.

site.label: Stitch length
site.others: Our rolled hem 1.5 figure is not on the page.

facts.value: Juki America FAQ: limited warranty two years on motors, light assembly, wiring, switches, circuit boards and speed control; five years on all other parts related to factory defects. Routine service, tension, skipping stitches not covered. Service is provided by the dealer you bought from
facts.spec_value: 5 yr mechanical, 2 yr electrical, 90 days labor (dealer statement of Juki warranty); consumables excluded
facts.note: The 90 days labor term is not in the maker FAQ wording; the 5 and 2 year terms match. FAQ is generic for home machines, not model-specific; no MO-644D warranty document found.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 2 yr motors, light, wiring, switches, circuit boards, speed control; 5 yr other parts (factory defects). Generic wording, not model-specific.
site.others: Dealers add 90 days labor, which is not in the maker FAQ.

facts.value: Juki Suggested Retail Price: $1,199.00 USD; page says contact an authorized dealer for pricing
facts.note: MSRP is the maker's printed figure, not a street price; the 654DE page prints $1,399.00. Never state either as a dealer price.

facts.value: Manual linked from the MO-644D page is titled MO-644DN/654DEN (mo-654_654de file name)
facts.note: The DN suffix and a 220-240 V foot control model suggest a regional edition. Matching 644D values (7.0 kg, 6/4/2 mm, 1 to 4 mm, 5 mm lift) agree with the page. Model name is not a spec: confirm before treating the manual as the 644D document.

site.label: Manual
site.juki: Linked from the page but titled MO-644DN/654DEN.

facts.value: Quoted marketing: "Heavy Duty Knife System"; "Tension: Industrial Type Dial"; "Easy-to-operate, durable and dependable"; "Flip and roll"; "Bright Lights - Better View"; "affordable price"
facts.note: All are maker claims, not spec rows. The catalog description for lighter and heavy fabrics ("light to heavy weight fabrics") sits in the 654DE paragraph; the 644D page claims light and heavy weight cutting for the knife system only.

site.label: Maker claims
site.juki: "Heavy Duty Knife System" and "Industrial Type Dial" are Juki wording.

facts.value: No discontinued or unavailable notice on the page (2026-10-02 fetch)
facts.note: The page still lists the machine and MSRP; the contact form's model dropdown omits the MO-644D (lists MO-654DE, MO-655, MO-734DE, MO-1000). Page wording only.

site.label: Availability
site.juki: Page live, no notice. Not in the contact form model list.
